description_en: Updates a custom prohibited software tag
description_zh: 更新自定义禁用软件标签
name: UpdateProhibitedTag

parameters.help_en: The name of the prohibited software tag. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, Chinese characters, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). Spaces are not supported
parameters.help_zh: 禁用软件标签名称。长度为1~128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-），不支持空格
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The description of the prohibited software tag. The description can contain letters, digits, Chinese characters, spaces, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-), and cannot exceed 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 禁用软件标签描述。支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、空格、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-），长度不超过128个字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the custom prohibited software tag. Only custom tags under the current Alibaba Cloud account can be modified. Built-in system tags cannot be modified. You can obtain the value from the following operations:
[ListProhibitedTags](~~ListProhibitedTags~~): Lists prohibited software tags.
[CreateProhibitedTag](~~CreateProhibitedTag~~): Creates a custom prohibited software tag
parameters.help_zh:
自定义禁用软件标签ID。仅支持修改当前阿里云账号下的自定义标签，系统内置标签不支持修改。取值来源：
[ListProhibitedTags](~~ListProhibitedTags~~)：批量查询禁用软件标签。
[CreateProhibitedTag](~~CreateProhibitedTag~~)：创建自定义禁用软件标签
parameters.name: tag_id

CreateTime.description_en: The creation time of the prohibited software tag, in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format. The time is displayed in UTC+8
CreateTime.description_zh: 禁用软件标签的创建时间，格式为yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss，使用UTC+8时区

Description.description_en: The description of the prohibited software tag

Name.description_en: The name of the prohibited software tag

TagId.description_en: The ID of the prohibited software tag
